title: Reading The PDF Changes Nothing
description: Printing a copy of an invoice for the customer's records shouldn't leave a mark on the original ledger entry.
successCondition: Create an invoice, record its status/amountCents/currency/createdAt from GET /api/billing/invoices/:id, then call GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/pdf three times in a row (each returns 200 with Content-Type application/pdf and a body starting with the %PDF- magic number). Re-fetch GET /api/billing/invoices/:id afterward and confirm every field is byte-identical to before — also confirm via `npm run db:psql` that the invoices row's updated nothing (status/amount_cents/currency/created_at unchanged, and no new payments rows were created).
hints: PDF generation is a pure read — it derives the document from the existing Invoice row and never calls prisma.invoice.update or prisma.payment.create.
Compare the full JSON of both GET /api/billing/invoices/:id responses rather than eyeballing individual fields, so nothing subtle slips by.
